name: How much does drywall installation typically cost per square foot?

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall installation typically cost per square foot?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of drywall installation can vary based on several factors, including the type of drywall, the complexity of the job, and local labor rates. Basic drywall installation in Pasadena might range from $2.00 to $3.50 per square foot for materials and labor. This estimate generally covers hanging, taping, mudding, and sanding. Additional costs can arise for specialty drywall (like moisture-resistant or fire-rated), intricate architectural details, or extensive surface preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall installation costs in Pasadena typically range from $2.00 to $3.50 per square foot, covering materials and labor for basic hanging, taping, and finishing.
